study.title: Acupuncture Modulates the Cerebello-Thalamo-Cortical Circuit and Cognitive Brain Regions in Patients of Parkinson's Disease With Tremor
study.study_design: Randomized controlled trial with three parallel arms: true acupuncture group, sham acupuncture group, and waiting group
study.randomization: Randomly assigned using a computer-generated list based on consecutive numbers that were distributed in sealed, opaque envelopes
study.blinding: Clinical evaluators remained blinded throughout the study; fMRI data analyser was blinded to the group assignment; patients were blinded during the treatment period by receiving treatment in different independent single-rooms; acupuncturist was not blinded to group assignment
study.inclusion_criteria: Diagnosed based on the UK PD Society Brain Bank clinical diagnostic criteria; tremor at rest in at least one upper or lower extremity on either side assessed by item 20 of the UPDRS
study.exclusion_criteria: Secondary Parkinsonism, atypical parkinsonian disease, advanced PD stage (H-Y >= 4), age less than 45 or greater than 80 years, history of other neurological disorders or head trauma, left-handedness, cognitive impairment (MMSE score <24), depression tendency (BDI score >4), and any contraindications for fMRI

arms.dropouts: No patients were withdrawn from the TAG

Two subjects excluded (one diagnosed with acute ischaemic stroke by fMRI, one withdrew due to lack of efficacy, one refused to re-scan fMRI) — total 2 excluded plus 2 withdrawn (n=2 excluded initially, n=2 withdrawn: 1 lack of efficacy, 1 refused fMRI re-scan)
One subject excluded (accidental fall); two withdrawn (one lost to follow-up, one refused fMRI re-scan)

conditions.scan_context: Resting-state fMRI; subjects asked to close their eyes and lie quietly; scan performed at least 4 h after levodopa administration
Resting-state fMRI; subjects asked to close their eyes and lie quietly; scan performed at least 4 h after levodopa administration

interventions.anatomical_location_exact: DU20 (Baihui), GB20 (Fengchi), and the Chorea-Tremor Controlled Zone located at the scalp above the front of precentral gurus, 1.5 cm before Motor Zone
interventions.laterality_exact: bilateral and equivalent number of acupoint each time
interventions.penetration_exact: inserted to a depth of 2.0–3.0 cm
interventions.manipulation_exact: The reinforcing-reducing method conducted by twirling was performed every 10 min within the 30-min needle retention time
interventions.practitioner_description_exact: A single experienced acupuncturist, who was not blinded to the group assignment
interventions.treatment_rationale_given_exact: to alleviate tremor according to traditional Chinese medicine documents

neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: T2-weighted gradient-recalled echo-planar imaging (GRE-EPI); structural images: three-dimensional T1-weighted magnetization-prepared rapid gradient echo (MPRAGE)
neuroimaging_methods.voxel_size_exact: 3-mm isotropic resolution (resampled); thickness = 3.5 mm, gap = 0.35 mm (functional acquisition); thickness = 1.0 mm (structural)
neuroimaging_methods.preprocessing_software_exact: DPABI based on MATLAB (The Math Works, Natick, MA, USA)
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: Gaussian filter (6-mm full-width half-maximum, FWHM) applied before the ALFF analysis but after the ReHo calculation
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: None of the participants were excluded based on the criteria of displacement >2 mm or angular rotation >2° in any direction
neuroimaging_methods.global_signal_regression_exact: 24 head-motion parameters, white matter signals, and cerebrospinal fluid signals were regressed using a general linear model; linear trends were removed

extraction_notes.note: No sensory, deqi, expectancy, credibility, or blinding success data were reported. The paper does not describe any measurement of participant-reported sensations during acupuncture administration.
No trial registration number was reported anywhere in the paper.
No data availability statement was reported.

The paper states the neuroimaging analyses used REST V1.8, while preprocessing used DPABI. The DC analysis used a threshold of r > 0.25 applied to correlation coefficients to remove weak correlations caused by noise. This threshold is separate from the AlphaSim cluster threshold and is specific to DC.

Table 2 reports n=11 for WG and n=12 for SAG in clinical evaluations, but n=10 for WG and n=11 for SAG in fMRI analyses (per Figure 1 flow chart). The clinical outcome entries use the clinical evaluation n values (WG=11, SAG=12, TAG=14). The neural results use the fMRI analysis n values (WG=10, SAG=11, TAG=14) but exact per-contrast n values are not reported in the tables.

The paper does not report between-group statistical comparisons for UPDRS II, III, or sub-scores. Only within-group pre-post changes were statistically tested using paired t-tests. No between-group inferential statistics are reported for clinical outcomes.
The 'Peak intensity' values in the neuroimaging tables are not explicitly labeled as t-statistics. They are labeled 'Peak intensity' in the tables. These have been preserved as reported.
The paper does not report an SAG<WG or TAG<SAG comparison for ALFF beyond what is listed in Table 5. No SAG<WG ALFF result was observed and reported in Table 5.

The sham acupuncture needle type is not explicitly stated (only that needles were inserted to 0.2 cm deep at sham locations). It is unclear whether the same stainless steel needles were used as in the true acupuncture group.

The cluster extent threshold is stated as >2,295 mm3 (85 voxels). This implies 27 mm3 per voxel (3mm isotropic). This is consistent with the reported 3-mm resampling. No conversion was performed; the paper's own statement was used.
The PMID for this article was not reported in the provided PDF. The DOI is 10.3389/fnagi.2018.00206.
No between-group ANCOVA or post-hoc difference values (e.g., mean difference with CI) for clinical outcomes were reported. Only within-group paired t-tests and T-values were provided.

The paper states the ANCOVA was performed 'on the fMRI data to identify the DC, ReHo and ALFF maps among three groups with the pretreatment images as covariates.' The exact ANCOVA model specification (e.g., inclusion of other covariates such as age, PD duration) beyond pretreatment images is not reported.
